scripts.dev: bun run build && concurrently --kill-others --names package,examples "bun run --cwd packages/fluidbox build:core --watch --no-clean" "bun run --cwd apps/examples dev"
scripts.build:examples: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/examples build
scripts.lint:all: bun run lint && bun run lint:typecheck
scripts.test:ssr: bun run build && bun run scripts/check-ssr.ts
scripts.test:bundle: bun run build && bun run scripts/check-bundles.ts
scripts.test:browser:visual: bun run build && playwright test --grep "visually stable" --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=pixel-7
scripts.test:browser:baseline: bun run build && BASELINE_CAPTURE=1 playwright test tests/browser/baseline.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.preview:share: bun run build:examples && portless fluidbox-prod --lan --tailscale bun run --cwd apps/examples preview
scripts.docs: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/docs dev
scripts.build:docs: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
